model_architecture: XLMRobertaModel, 24 layers -- fine-tuned from BAAI/bge-m3 via CachedGISTEmbedLoss on ~1.88M Korean query-document pairs. Pure bidirectional encoder, never a decoder-only/generative architecture.

normalization.mechanism: sentence-transformers pipeline module 2 = Normalize (L2), per modules.json

supported_languages: Korean, English (primary training focus); base BAAI/bge-m3 itself covers 100+ languages

estimated_memory_gb_range.basis: model.safetensors is 2.27GB (fp32, ~560M-param XLM-RoBERTa-large scale). Range assumes typical CPU inference overhead (activations, tokenizer, batching) on top of resident weights; not independently profiled this Turn (no model download performed).

competition_status_reason: Pure XLM-RoBERTa bidirectional encoder (via BAAI/bge-m3 lineage + RetroMAE pretraining), architecturally incapable of autoregressive generation -- not derived from any generative/decoder LLM (the CLAUDE.md concern, exemplified by the Qwen-embedding family, does not apply to this BERT/RoBERTa-lineage architecture). MIT license, immutable revision and dimension both confirmed from the official HuggingFace repository -- no blocker identified for a bounded, Gold-blind calibration smoke.

adapter_compatibility.reason: No provider-hosted official HTTP embeddings endpoint exists for this open-weight model. It CAN be served locally via HuggingFace's own Text Embeddings Inference (TEI), whose /v1/embeddings endpoint already accepts {input, model} and returns {data:[{embedding}]} -- byte-shape-compatible with the existing HTTP_EMBEDDINGS adapter contract with zero new protocol code. This Turn does not install or run any such server.
